scientific_question: Can unrestricted layer-private residual-input and residual-write coordinate maps around the two learned late-depth trunks reproduce the missing late-layer value and derivative fields while leaving the five already-working singleton layers exactly unchanged?

causal_basis.two_bank_atomwise_finding: Complete-neuron interpolation preserves the endpoint and optimizes healthily but achieves only 0.5103 output and 0.1613 input-JVP recovery; matched late-bank atoms have only 0.0966 mean semantic cosine. Scalar chords do not trace the required nonlinear chart.
causal_basis.private_residual_spectrum_finding: Rank-64 residual subspaces transfer but the actual task-gradient directions are data-dependent. The ceiling must test a distributed coordinate map rather than a fixed additive low-rank correction.
causal_basis.postbranch_finding: An output-only post-branch FC recovered branch values but failed derivatives and catastrophically worsened composition. The input-side map is mandatory because it moves GELU activation boundaries.
causal_basis.representation_change: For late layer l, replace the shared function V_g GELU(p_l * U_g x) by C_l V_g GELU(p_l * U_g A_l x), with unrestricted A_l and C_l in residual space. Keep layers 0-4 bitwise at their sealed seven-trunk endpoint during the repair fit.
causal_basis.why_a_ceiling: Every low-rank, Monarch, Householder, butterfly, or BlockFHT residual-coordinate transport is a subset of unrestricted A_l and C_l. Failure closes that entire factorization direction; success permits spectrum-guided factorization rather than a blind structure sweep.
causal_basis.not_a_sweep: There is one identity initialization, one maps-only stage, one joint late-bank stage, one seed, and no rank, factorization, regularizer, optimizer, or restart sweep.

family.definition: F_l(x)=C_l V_g(l) GELU(p_l elementwise-multiplied by U_g(l) A_l x), followed by the existing positive residual-output gain. A_l and C_l are unrestricted 768x768 maps only for layers 5-11.
family.initialization: All A_l and C_l start at identity; all trunks and gains are copied from the sealed seven-trunk checkpoint. The initial function is exactly the checkpoint. Layers 0-4 and their gains remain frozen throughout the oracle.
family.deployment: Fold A_l into U_g(l) and C_l into V_g(l) at refresh, then cache ordinary dense matrices. Cached token-time and inference GEMM FLOPs are unchanged.

fit_protocol.objective: Equal-weight sum of separately normalized clean-output error and central-difference direction error on dense-teacher and seven-trunk state banks. Layers 0-4 remain exact constants and contribute only immutable diagnostics.

stages.name: coefficients_only
stages.trainable: the fourteen late-layer residual coordinate maps only

stages.name: joint_late_banks_maps
stages.trainable: two late trunk matrix pairs, fourteen coordinate maps, and late per-layer gains; singleton trunks and layers 0-4 gains stay frozen

fit_protocol.best_state_rule: Within each stage preserve the state with the smallest discovery objective. The second stage warm-starts the first. Holdout values, fixed CE, wall time, and gate outcomes never select a state.
fit_protocol.parameter_clamps: Late pre-GELU gains are clamped to [-4,4] and late residual-output log gains to [-4,4]. Coordinate maps and late trunk matrices are unconstrained.

report: stagewise discovery and holdout value-direction objectives
held-out output and analytic input-JVP recovery by layer and state bank
singular-energy spectra of A_l-I and C_l-I for future factorization
fixed-checkpoint validation CE after the terminal stage
parameter, refresh-FLOP, online-FLOP, peak-memory, and wall-time accounting

frozen_gates.optimization_healthy: Finite terminal execution and either terminal discovery objective at most 0.5 or at least 50-percent reduction from the joint-stage initial objective.

decision_rule.pass: Use the measured A_l-I and C_l-I spectra to preregister one minimum-capacity factorization, then require that compact factorization to pass the same oracle before any LM training.
decision_rule.healthy_fail: Reject the entire residual-coordinate factorization direction. Do not try low-rank, Monarch, Householder, butterfly, or BlockFHT approximations of A_l and C_l.
decision_rule.optimization_inconclusive: Stop and report without a capacity conclusion or LM training.

authorization.allowed: Implement and run this exact zero-LM-update full-rank ceiling after focused tests and measured preflight.
not_allowed: rank, factorization, optimizer, learning-rate, stage-length, seed, gain, or regularizer sweeps
updating layers 0-4 during the repair fit
authorization.callback_policy: Foreground-poll if measured complete runtime is at most five minutes; otherwise launch one verified terminal/failure @Codex watchdog.
